title: Transitions and Animations
description: Learn how to create smooth transitions and animations using CSS properties.

quiz.question: What CSS property is used to create smooth changes between property values?
quiz.explanation: The transition property controls the speed of property changes over time.

quiz.question: Which CSS rule defines the intermediate steps in an animation?
quiz.explanation: @keyframes specifies the stages of an animation sequence.

quiz.question: How do you specify the duration of a CSS transition?
quiz.explanation: transition-duration sets how long the transition takes to complete.

quiz.question: Which property controls the timing function of a transition (e.g., ease, linear)?
quiz.explanation: It defines the speed curve of the transition.

quiz.question: How do you apply an animation named 'slide' to an element?
quiz.explanation: animation-name links the animation to the keyframes rule.

quiz.question: Which property sets the number of times an animation should play?
quiz.explanation: It defines how many times the animation repeats.

quiz.question: What does 'animation-fill-mode: forwards;' do?
options: Keeps the final state of the animation after it finishes
Starts the animation from the beginning
quiz.correctAnswer: Keeps the final state of the animation after it finishes
quiz.explanation: This property makes sure the element stays in the last keyframe state.

quiz.question: Which shorthand property can be used to define all animation properties at once?
quiz.explanation: The animation shorthand allows you to specify name, duration, timing function, etc.

quiz.question: True or False: CSS transitions can animate all CSS properties.
quiz.explanation: Only certain CSS properties, like color and transform, can be smoothly transitioned.

quiz.question: What is the default value of 'animation-iteration-count'?
quiz.explanation: By default, an animation runs once unless specified otherwise.
